info.title: Trado Firebase Backend — Local Emulator API
info.description:
Authoritative OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract for the Trado Firebase backend.

**188 HTTPS Callable functions** across 40 domains.
**8 Firestore Triggers** (internal event-driven background automation).

⚠️ **LOCAL EMULATOR ONLY** — Targets loopback Firebase Emulator Suite (`127.0.0.1:5001`).
Do NOT use this contract against production cloud endpoints.

Generated from canonical source exports and validation schemas (196 total exports).
Input schemas derived from 213 Zod schemas via z.toJSONSchema().
